Author: Anna, beerpsi
Name: ExtraChatFork
Description:
ExtraChat adds end-to-end encrypted, cross-data-centre, unlimited linkshells
to the game. (Fork of official plugin with features and some fixes)
Changelog:
# Features
- /ecl now chooses the ExtraChat linkshell you last sent a message to, rather than the first
linkshell.

# Fixes
- Un-fix sending auto-translate commands as a message when placed at the beginning. This lines up with
vanilla game behavior. To send an auto-translate command as a message, send "/eclX <auto-translate>".
- Fix chat entry color in Chat 2 when using in-game linkshell/CWLS as the output channel.
